'''''The Paradise Snare''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel written by [[A. C. Crispin]]. It is the first volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Han Solo Trilogy]]'', and it was first published by [[Bantam Spectra]] on [[May 5]], [[1997]]. A sequel, ''[[The Hutt Gambit]]'', was published later that year. The complete trilogy was reprinted in [[The Han Solo Trilogy (hardcover)|''The Han Solo Trilogy'']] ([[1998]]).
